source.source_title: Animal genotype, stress and fluoxetine treatment: emotionality index
modifications: Extract 67 animal-level observations from environment-table43.html in source order
Remove 18 published average/stdv/sterror rows and five all-blank separator rows from Input to prevent answer leakage
Treat Animal identifiers as strings, retaining mixed alphabetic/numeric original spellings
Pivot treatment values Vehicle and Fluoxetine to side-by-side Animal ID and Emotionality Index pairs under merged two-level headers
Retain all independent cohort measurements; never imply animal-level pairing between treatments
Generate Mean, sample SD and SEM rows within each observed genotype/group, computed from individual measurements
Display the three observed genotype/group row groups using merged cells

operation_nodes.target: Wide cohort records by Genotype + Group; Vehicle and Fluoxetine child columns
Two-level merged treatment headers and genotype/group row-section merges
Three computed statistic rows for each observed genotype/group

rules.group_local_alignment: Position only; independent animals are not biologically paired
rules.incomplete_group_policy: No FGF2KO Control group; do not synthesize any missing combination
rules.source_record_policy: Keep all 67 animal IDs and numeric index values attached to their original factor labels
rules.sample_sd: Use unbiased sample standard deviation with N-1 denominator (STDEV.S)
rules.formula_cache_policy: Gold has cached values; evaluator also accepts known, exact, safe uncached formulas
rules.rounding: No rounding of underlying numeric values

evaluation.scaffold: Agent receives input.xlsx plus instruction.txt only

publication_policy: Public example with Gold disclosed; do not include in held-out test
